data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'Endon' meaning 'in' and 'ora' meaning 'face', Endora translates to 'God's Enduring One'. This name evokes images of strength, resilience, and unwavering faith. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Endora usually hope their child will grow to embody god's enduring one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
